_note: Episode 21 (S3E1) keyframes (from Kabanata 21, story version 2). Biringan is a legend of Samar, shown as a dreamlike city behind fog, never as a real map or a real place. Tala: a young Filipina woman with snow-white hair and pale silver eyes, long black coat, wide-brimmed hat; never drawn as 'Nordic' or with any racial-ideology imagery. Usman appears only in the light of the open lagusan on the beach (Kabanata 21); present-day scenes elsewhere have the empty sidecar with his red kerchief. No real person is shown speaking. Copied from Episode 13: full intro. Shots follow sentences.json; k90+ are montage extras.
